test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025: Morning Practice Day 2
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, BROKE is written as 125, and CURES is written as 146. How will TOWEL be coded in that language?
solution:
**The logic followed here is:

(Product of positional value of vowels) + (sum of the reverse positional value of the consonants)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

BROKE - 125

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c139d7fd6120d8878612f24669905dd942f97aab86e224ad34840d24c76cadbd.png] 

(15 x 5) + (25 + 9 + 16)

= 75 + 50

= 125

 

CURES - 146

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c499be4f627037fe4acb3ac0f502412b0b72c18978603384cece5cfb4252ab86.png] 

(21 x 5) + (24 + 9 + 8)

= 105 + 41

= 146

Similarly,

TOWEL - 101

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7e8ea509a6538fecd3d357be159388bc1b6bad357c0ec2d044982f6c66032f.png] 

(15 x 5) + (7 + 4 + 15)

= 75 + 26

= 101

**Hence, the code for TOWEL is 101.**
